annotations.title: Get the text of a legal act

description: Get the text of a Polish legal act, or of one of its articles, as plain text. Whole acts come in pages of 20,000 characters by default (codes are over 400,000); continue with offset. The text is the act as published: the current wording of an amended act is in its newest consolidated text (references of type Inf. o tekście jednolitym in get-act). Acts published only as a PDF return the PDF link.

article.description: Return only this article, e.g. 415, 3a or 18^3a for Art. 18 with superscript 3a; omit to get the whole act

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters to return; defaults to 20000

offset.description: Character at which to start; use the offset given at the end of a truncated text to continue

position.description: Position in the journal: the last part of the ELI (1 in DU/2024/1)

publisher.description: Journal the act was published in: DU for Dziennik Ustaw or MP for Monitor Polski. The ELI field of a legislative process (get-process, get-passed-processes) such as DU/2024/1 is exactly publisher/year/position, and so is the ELI of acts from search-acts

year.description: Year of publication: the middle part of the ELI (2024 in DU/2024/1)

name: get-act-text
title: Get the text of a legal act
